audience: machine learning engineers who look for models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hugging Face Hub

useCases.title: Search the Hub with one query
useCases.text: Search models, datasets, Spaces, papers and collections with one query. List the files of a repository at a branch to see what it contains.

useCases.title: Find a demo Space for a task
useCases.text: Search Spaces by what they do, for example a photo-to-cartoon app. Filter by category or include Spaces that are not running.

useCases.title: Research papers on a topic
useCases.text: Search the research papers indexed on Hugging Face. Open a paper by its arXiv-style ID to see its details.

useCases.title: Review a curated collection
useCases.text: List collections by text, owner or sort order. Open one to see its models, datasets, Spaces and papers.

useCases.title: Check credits and notifications
useCases.text: Read the credits balance and its expiry dates. List your newest notifications about discussions, pull requests and mentions.
